description: This file defines the JsonBody class, which is responsible for formatting the JSON body of API requests in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for generating appropriate content types, building JSON payloads from shapes and arguments, and formatting data according to shape types like structure, list, map, blob, and timestamp.

classes.name: JsonBody
classes.description: Formats the JSON body of a JSON-REST or JSON-RPC API operation in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a specific AWS API service object.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Determines the Content-Type header value based on the service's metadata.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a JSON string payload from the given shape and arguments.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Recursively formats data according to shape type into an array suitable for JSON encoding.
